newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain union says labour reforms credible, balanced.
newsitem.headline: Spain union says labour reforms credible, balanced.

text.p: Spain's leading unions welcomed on Wednesday planned labour reforms agreed with employers and said they would help to improve and increase jobs.
"It is credible because it is balanced," Antonio Gutierrez, secretary general of the Workers Commission union (CCOO) told a news conference.
Spain's unions and employers revealed their long-awaited proposals on labour reforms on Wednesday. They reached a preliminary agreement in March and have been drafting the accord since then.
Gutierrez said the deal with employers "is a serious contribution to the improvement of jobs, as well as to quantity and quality of jobs."
He added that both sides had made significant concessions, without which an accord would not have been possible.
The reforms must still be approved by the two sides' executive committees later this month, although they are expected to win overwhelming approval.
